Step 1: Start date: 1901-06-18.  
Step 2: 40 weeks = 40 × 7 = 280 days.  
Step 3: Add 6 more days → total subtract 286 days.  
Step 4: 1901 is not a leap year (1900 not leap, 1901 not divisible by 4).  
Days before June 18 in 1901: Jan 31 + Feb 28 + Mar 31 + Apr 30 + May 31 = 151 days.  
June 18 is day 169 of year (151 + 18).  
169 − 286 = −117 days → go back into 1900.  
1900 is not a leap year (divisible by 100, not by 400).  
Days in 1900 = 365.  
365 − 117 = 248 days into 1900.  
248 days: Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31 → sum to 31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31 = 243 days (end of Aug).  
248 − 243 = 5 → September 5, 1900.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1900-09-05
